scope: Targeted review of three public primary source descriptions; not an exhaustive data search. No data imported or relabeled. Source claims are not independently verified participant identities.

sources.name: RoSafetyBench
sources.reported_scope: 953 Romanian safety prompts; 148 author-written seeds and 805 model-expanded records. Data card declares CC-BY-4.0. Refusal labels use model judges.
sources.reported_limitations: Independent native-speaker audit remains undone. The card acknowledges malformed expanded text, incorrect categories/expected behavior, and unverified factual references.
sources.assessment: Potential external exploratory prompt source after annotation; does not supply independent RoGuard conversation or response labels.

sources.name: Ukrainian LLM Safety Dataset
sources.reported_scope: Nine national-security threat classes, 59,377 training samples and a reportedly human-verified 450-sample benchmark. Restricted research license; files are gated.
sources.assessment: Access and use rights have not been established. Taxonomy does not directly label child-review concerns or the five response behaviors. No access request submitted and no gated data accessed.

sources.name: UAlign
sources.reported_scope: 3,682 moral-judgment scenarios and 1,700 ethical situations with English/Ukrainian pairs. Machine translation with model-based linguistic validation.
sources.assessment: Related Ukrainian alignment benchmark, but its moral labels cannot be treated as RoGuard review labels or independent native-language response annotations.
